note: The record of every RocketChat private-group access request, its approval, and its fulfilment. This is the chat-surface analogue of access_register.json (which governs ownCloud shares). The nightly recertification job reads the `fulfilment` block of each request: a request whose fulfilment.status is `fulfilled` is treated as closed. A request is only fulfillable once its approval.status is `approved`; a request still `open` has NOT been signed off and must be routed through scripts/membership_approval.sh before anyone is added. Fulfilment (the actual groups.invite) and approval are separate acts recorded by whoever performs each.
scope_note: A request names exactly ONE target group, and fulfilment is scoped to that group. finance-reporting and records-governance carry need-to-know material and are not the target of any request in this queue.
